answer: Farming becomes a signal bet on surviving 54 epochs of grading, and every glacier settlement recomputes the falcon schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 54 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
